description: The agent must: (1) Locate all .txt files under the 'raw' interview directories (4 files across two fieldwork seasons). (2) For each file, remove the first line (the session title/header). (3) Convert every timecode line from 'Speaker MM:SS' format to '[hh:mm:ss]Speaker' format — critically, the timecode moves BEFORE the speaker name with NO space between ']' and the speaker. (4) Handle the minutes-to-hours rollover: e.g., '65:45' must become '[01:05:45]', not '[00:65:45]' — this is the key proprietary trap that a generic agent will likely fail. (5) Strip UTF-8 BOM from the file that was saved with one (session_03_participantC.txt). (6) Overwrite each original file in place. The agent must read the SKILL.md to discover the exact Perl-based transformation logic, the [hh:mm:ss] bracket format, the no-space rule, the title-removal rule, and the hour-rollover arithmetic.
